mapper.select: select ppd.*, prp.LARGE_COMPANY_AMT as largeCompanyAmtPrd, prp.MEDIUM_COMPANY_AMT as mediumCompanyAmtPrd, prp.SMALL_COMPANY_AMT as smallCompanyAmtPrd, prp.MICRO_COMPANY_AMT as microCompanyAmtPrd, prp.OTH_AMT as othAmtPrd, prp.SUM_AMT as sumAmtPrd from PBC_REPORT_COMPANY_DAT ppd left join PBC_REPORT_COMPANY prp on ppd.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and ppd.REPORTTYPE=prp.REPORTTYPE and ppd.propertyCode=prp.propertyCode where ppd.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR} and ppd.REPORTTYPE=#{reporttype,jdbcType=CHAR}

select prp.* from PBC_REPORT_COMPANY_DAT prp left join PBC_SEND_ZIP_DAT_FILE psz on psz.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE =prp.REPORTTYPE where psz.DAT_ZIP_CODE=#{datZipCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE = #{datZipDatType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and prp.PROPERTYCODE is not null and (prp.LARGE_COMPANY_AMT <> 0 or prp.MEDIUM_COMPANY_AMT <> 0 or prp.SMALL_COMPANY_AMT <> 0 or prp.MICRO_COMPANY_AMT <> 0 or prp.OTH_AMT <> 0 or prp.SUM_AMT <> 0)
